subject: pri-info
title: (R)PRI.INFO.------ MTA.RT.SIGN.
description: Chart on book p. 132 (AE(PD)-20). PRI-INFO (principle information) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; MTA-RT-SIGN (meta-reality significance) is the partner. From the subject: COS-P (cosmic particulars). From COS-P: SG (source initiation), with the (PO) prefix, "point of", T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and PHY-C. TH-CONT-DY (thrust continuance dynamics), with the (P-IN) prefix, "its position in", is on a dotted line from COS-P. From PHY-C: RT-DY (reality dynamics).
